justification: Defensive fix to send_telegram() in 4 monitor scripts: truncate at 4000 chars (Telegram limit 4096), log errors instead of bare except:pass. No logic changes, no new features.

pre_impl.existing_data: No data access. Only changes alerting output channel (Telegram send_telegram function).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumes Telegram API returns non-2xx on messages over 4096 chars. Verified via Telegram Bot API docs.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Modifies existing send_telegram functions in all four monitor scripts. No new data flows introduced.

functions.name: send_telegram
functions.input: msg: str — the full alert message text to send via Telegram
functions.output: None — sends truncated message to Telegram, logs errors to stderr
functions.if_none: Logs skip reason if no TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN or TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env var

functions.name: send_telegram
functions.input: message: str — the full DCP monitor alert message text
functions.output: None — sends truncated message to Telegram, logs errors to stderr
functions.if_none: Logs skip reason if no token or chat_id configured

break_it.what_happens: Message truncated to 3950 chars + suffix, total under 4096
break_it.how: Truncation at 4000 with ~50 char suffix stays under 4096 limit

break_it.scenario: Telegram API returns 400 Bad Request for other reasons
break_it.what_happens: Error logged to stderr with HTTP status and response body excerpt
break_it.how: resp.ok check + stderr logging at all 4 call sites
break_it.repro: Set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID to invalid value, trigger monitor

break_it.scenario: Network timeout on Telegram send — monitor hangs
break_it.what_happens: requests.post raises after 10s timeout, caught by except, logged to stderr
break_it.how: timeout=10 on all requests.post calls, exception handler logs rather than swallowing
break_it.repro: Block api.telegram.org at firewall level, trigger monitor

post_merge.manual_verify: Trigger watchdog via Railway API, verify Telegram message arrives truncated
